description: Presidential Secretariat - An Essential Public service for the Life of the Community. 01. All Services Connected to the Supply of Electricity. 02.The Supply or Distribution of Petroleum Products and Fuel
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential order issued under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979, declaring certain services (electricity supply and petroleum distribution) as essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action that establishes legal status and compliance requirements for these services, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
